question:
Study the table showing the maximum temperature of five cities over six months and answer the question.

City | Jan | Feb | Mar | Apr | May | Jun
Delhi | 20 | 23 | 30 | 38 | 42 | 40
Mumbai | 30 | 31 | 32 | 33 | 34 | 32
Kolkata | 26 | 28 | 34 | 36 | 37 | 35
Chennai | 29 | 30 | 32 | 34 | 37 | 38
Jaipur | 22 | 25 | 32 | 40 | 44 | 42

Q. Which city recorded the highest maximum temperature across all six months combined?
explanation: Summing temperatures for each city across all 6 months: Delhi = 20+23+30+38+42+40 = 193; Mumbai = 30+31+32+33+34+32 = 192; Kolkata = 26+28+34+36+37+35 = 196; Chennai = 29+30+32+34+37+38 = 200; Jaipur = 22+25+32+40+44+42 = 205. Jaipur has the highest sum (205). Option D (Chennai) is close with 200, but incorrect.
